description: This file defines the Media entity class for Drupal, including its properties, methods, and configuration for handling media items within the Drupal CMS. It includes class definitions, method implementations for media management, thumbnail handling, validation, and entity field definitions.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: Defines the media entity class for Drupal, managing media items, their properties, thumbnails, validation, and configuration.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the media entity, falling back to source metadata if name is empty.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the label of the media entity, alias for getName().

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name property of the media entity.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the media entity.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the media entity.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the media source associated with this media entity.

methods.name: updateThumbnail
methods.description: Updates the thumbnail for the media item, optionally from queue.

methods.name: loadThumbnail
methods.description: Loads or creates the file entity for the thumbnail based on URI.

methods.name: getDefaultThumbnailUri
methods.description: Returns the default thumbnail URI based on source plugin definition.

methods.name: updateQueuedThumbnail
methods.description: Queues an update for the thumbnail.

methods.name: getThumbnailUri
methods.description: Gets the URI for the thumbnail, considering queue status.

methods.name: getThumbnailWidth
methods.description: Gets the width of the thumbnail, considering queue status.

methods.name: getThumbnailHeight
methods.description: Gets the height of the thumbnail, considering queue status.

methods.name: hasSourceFieldChanged
methods.description: Checks if the source field value has changed.

methods.name: shouldUpdateThumbnail
methods.description: Determines if the thumbnail should be updated based on entity state.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Performs actions before saving the entity, such as setting owner and default thumbnail.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving, such as queuing thumbnail updates.

methods.name: preSaveRevision
methods.description: Prepares revision data before saving a revision.

methods.name: prepareSave
methods.description: Sets field values from source metadata before saving.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the media entity against source constraints.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines base fields for the media entity, including name, thumbnail, author, status, created, and changed.

methods.name: getRequestTime
methods.description: Returns the current request time.
